title: lathyrus maritimus var. pubescens
intro: Lathyrus maritimus var. pubescens, commonly known as the hairy sea pea or hairy lathyrus, is a plant species within the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus maritimus var. pubescens include anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
